passage:
The school kept ten yellow raincoats in the office for students who forgot umbrellas. Students could borrow one and return it the next day.
At first, many raincoats were not returned. The office almost ended the program.
Then a student suggested adding a tag inside each raincoat: "Please bring me home tomorrow. Another student may need me."
The message worked better than warnings. Students returned the raincoats more often.
The office kept the program.
The tag made students think about the next person, not only the rule. Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
